claim_protocol.expired_claim_rule: Inspect working tree, uncommitted changes and recent commits before reclaiming.

update_protocol: Read latest tasks.json from target branch before every update.
Claim tasks atomically; never overwrite full file from stale copy.
Change only task fields owned by worker; preserve unrelated records.
Validate JSON syntax, schema, unique IDs and dependency DAG after each update.
Record blockers/evidence; never invent completion times or test results.
Commit task state with implementation where practical.
Across machines, update tasks.json through one serialized writer with optimistic concurrency; never overwrite from a stale full-file copy.

global_gates.name: Repository and source baseline
global_gates.rule: No destructive refactor, schema migration or canon redesign before baseline evidence.

global_gates.name: Architecture and contract baseline
global_gates.rule: Parallel implementation starts only after identity, package and cross-realm contracts are reviewed.

global_gates.name: ORM proof of concept
global_gates.rule: Do not scale add-on models before metadata composition and request context are proven.

global_gates.name: First authorized vertical slice
global_gates.rule: A real workflow proves identity, API authorization, persisted state and UI outcome.

global_gates.name: Asset and canon safety
global_gates.rule: No asset/canon becomes production/approved without provenance, rights and policy review.

global_gates.name: Production readiness
global_gates.rule: Release only after reproducible builds, security, tests, operations and human approvals pass.

global_gates.name: DX-first safe task execution
global_gates.rule: Do not enable autonomous parallel local-agent execution before task claims, worktree isolation, sandbox and evidence validation work.

global_gates.name: Fourteen-app architecture baseline
global_gates.rule: App boundaries, source of truth and deployment classes must be approved before broad implementation.

global_gates.name: Central identity and secrets separation
global_gates.rule: Apps use registered identity clients; secret values remain in the vault.

global_gates.name: Telecom vertical ownership
global_gates.rule: OSS owns operational truth, BSS commercial truth, ISP service orchestration.

global_gates.name: Corpus/legal source integrity
global_gates.rule: Source classes, versions, jurisdiction, citations and visual boundaries are enforced.

global_gates.name: RIOT lab isolation
global_gates.rule: No red-team action occurs without exact authorization and isolated lab controls.
